source_text: Paulus servus Jesu Christi, vocatus apostolus, segregatus in Evangelium Dei. Vocatus non est idem quod electus — multi vocati, pauci electi. Segregatus in Evangelium: Deus segregat iustos a ventre; Paulus non fortuito sed secundum propositum vocatus est.
pass_a_gloss: Paul servant of Jesus Christ, called apostle, set apart into the Gospel of God. Called is not the same as elect — many called, few elect. Set apart into the Gospel: God sets apart the just from the womb; Paul was called not by chance but according to purpose.
pass_b_english: [[Called as an apostle, set apart for the gospel of God >> Bible:Romans 1:1]]. Calling is not yet election — [[many are called, few are chosen >> Bible:Matthew 22:14]]. God separates for the gospel [[according to his purpose >> Bible:Romans 8:28]], not by chance.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
